adapters.name: OpenCode
adapters.mechanism: v1 chat.message + experimental.chat.system.transform plugin and native TUI plugin
knownLimitations: Session state is process-local and resets on plugin reload or restart.
PREVIEW is advisory: the question tool is a model instruction, not a host execution barrier.

adapters.name: Pi
adapters.mechanism: Pi extension using before_agent_start with ctx.model and a preview tool
knownLimitations: The preview tool provides confirmation UI but is not a host-enforced mutation barrier.
Non-interactive print/JSON modes stop for explicit confirmation instead of an interactive editor.

adapters.name: Cursor
adapters.mechanism: beforeSubmitPrompt state bridge plus an always-on rule
knownLimitations: beforeSubmitPrompt cannot inject arbitrary additional context; a small runtime state file is consumed by the rule.
Stale runtime state is possible until the next submit updates it.

adapters.name: Gemini CLI
adapters.mechanism: BeforeAgent preflight plus observation-only BeforeModel model capture and GEMINI.md
knownLimitations: BeforeAgent does not expose the resolved model ID; exact routing begins only after the first BeforeModel observation.
CLI --model is not visible to BeforeAgent, so exact first-turn routing is not claimed for that case.
The model snapshot is last-observed: switching models may lag by one user-turn.

adapters.name: Claude Code
knownLimitations: Exact model identity depends on what the runtime exposes or the user configures.

adapters.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
knownLimitations: Config-file userPromptSubmitted hooks cannot rewrite the prompt; modifiedPrompt is SDK-programmatic only.

adapters.name: OpenAI Codex
knownLimitations: Automatic routing uses exact runtime identity only when the agent exposes it to its own context.

adapters.name: Windsurf
adapters.mechanism: shared skills plus .windsurf/rules project or global rules
